payload.text: LESSONS candidate (15), from 0123's review, cc's lesson with vc's miss as its instance: a targeted test run includes helpers.bats and contract.bats whatever the change. A source-scan arm exercises no command, so a selection chosen by which commands a change touches misses it. vc approved 0123 v2 on six targeted files, 223 of 223, and the full suite then failed two helpers.bats scans on it: a raw sha256 binary in an arm, and a bare mv, the 2026-09-17 hang's shape.
